name: keepr
description: Offline-first receipt, expense, and document management
author: Joshua Roberts
_pinning_note: ABI-critical natives (electron, better-sqlite3, sharp, @electron/rebuild) are pinned EXACTLY, no carets. A minor bump in any of them changes NODE_MODULE_VERSION expectations and produces the 'fixed itself after a rebuild' class of non-reproducible failure. Do not add ^ or ~ to these four.

scripts.start: npm run rebuild:electron --silent && npm run build && electron dist/main/index.js
scripts.test: npm run rebuild:node --silent && node --experimental-strip-types --test src/db/repo/__tests__/*.ts src/ocr/__tests__/*.ts src/store/__tests__/*.ts

build._asarUnpack_note: sharp ships platform packages under @img and loads libvips from disk; better-sqlite3 is a classic .node addon; tesseract.js needs its wasm core and traineddata reachable as real files. All of these fail if left inside the asar archive. The app would launch and then die on first import.
